CalendarYearLadderRow.description: Calendar-year non-principal / principal / PV totals for one reporting year.

non_principal.description:
Sum of amounts that are not [`CFKind::is_principal_like`] in that year,
in the flow's native units (interest, fees, recovery, and unknown-kind
flows are not mixed in: unknown labels are rejected).

principal.description: Sum of [`CFKind::is_principal_like`] amounts in that year.

pv.description: Sum of present values in that year, in the same units as `non_principal`.

year.description: Calendar year of the grouped cashflows (Gregorian, as on `Date::year`).

description: One row currency's calendar-year non-principal, principal and native PV ladder.

currency.description: Row currency every figure of `rows` is stated in.

rows.description: Calendar-year non-principal, principal and native PV totals, by ascending year.

title: CurrencyLadder
